stable.label: native-cpp-kernel-ci-pass
stable.note: The active C++/WebAssembly material kernel on main has fresh Codehood, Foundation, and Pages deployment passes. The state-derived surface-mesh increment is implemented with deterministic tests but remains pending CI until its branch workflow passes. No live browser or iPhone runtime verification is claimed.

active_experience.runtime: from-scratch C++ compiled to WebAssembly owns material state; JavaScript Worker bridge transfers packed state; Canvas renderer reconstructs procedural surface geometry; no third-party game, physics, rendering, or simulation libraries
render_coupling: terrain surface heights come from highest occupied native solid cells
surface normals come from neighboring native column heights
water turbidity consumes simulated suspended sediment
water surface height comes from native water occupancy
approximations: water is a cellular occupancy transport model, not Navier-Stokes CFD and has no explicit velocity/pressure field
surface meshing is presentation geometry and does not increase simulation resolution
active native route currently has no native articulated creature physics
active native route currently has no learning or evolution system
Canvas projection is software presentation, not a 3D rigid-body renderer

native_surface_render.truth: procedural surface geometry and material appearance are reconstructed from packed native simulation state; the renderer does not feed back into physics
tests: simulated moisture reaches terrain appearance input
simulated sediment reaches water turbidity input
fake sine-wave water animation forbidden by active-route gate

active_objective: Promote the state-derived native surface renderer only after independent GitHub CI, then add physically meaningful native fluid momentum/pressure state rather than cosmetic water animation.
next_gate: Native surface branch must pass deterministic Codehood verification before merge. LIVE_TESTED and DEVICE_TESTED require actual deployed browser/iPhone execution.
next_scientific_blocker: The native water model transports occupancy but does not yet represent a velocity field, pressure, or momentum conservation. A bounded next physics increment should add explicit native fluid momentum/pressure state with conservation/stability tests before claiming CFD-like behavior.
invariants: renderer geometry must derive from native state
do not call cellular water CFD
do not present presentation interpolation as physics
no fake scripted wave motion presented as fluid simulation
Stable vs Lab isolation must remain fail-closed
CI_PASS does not imply LIVE_TESTED or DEVICE_TESTED
